content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 4 up, 1 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 6 of 6 planned. Sets: 84 (last week 84).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- 槓鈴臥推: 225 lb x 8 (last week 225 lb x 8), flat (3 weeks without a new best), 8 sets this week
- 深蹲: 220.5 lb x 6 (last week 215 lb x 6), estimated 1RM up 2.6%, 8 sets this week
- 槓鈴划船: 154.3 lb x 8 (last week 148.8 lb x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 8 sets this week
- 羅馬尼亞硬舉: 198.4 lb x 8 (last week 192.9 lb x 8), estimated 1RM up 2.9%, 8 sets this week
- 肩推: 99.2 lb x 8 (last week 93.7 lb x 8), estimated 1RM up 5.9%, 8 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): 深蹲 220.5 lb x 6; 槓鈴划船 154.3 lb x 8; 羅馬尼亞硬舉 198.4 lb x 8; 肩推 99.2 lb x 8.
Sets per muscle this week, where a muscle an exercise trains on the side counts half a set (range 10-20 a week for 胸, 背, 肩中束, 肩後束, 股四頭, 腿後側, 臀, 二頭, 三頭; the others have no range): 胸 18 (last week 18), 背 23 (last week 23), 肩前束 15 (last week 15), 肩中束 10 (last week 10), 肩後束 10 (last week 10), 股四頭 14 (last week 14), 腿後側 12 (last week 12), 臀 22 (last week 22), 二頭 13 (last week 13), 三頭 15 (last week 15), 小腿 2 (last week 2).
Body weight: 177 lb (+0 lb), 1 weigh-in(s) this week.
Weights are in lb; write every weight in lb.
The user's goal: "增肌".
The user's note for this week (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): none.
Rules that fired, most important first; each has one or more items:
- lift_stalled (priority 60). Advice: Double progression: keep the weight and add reps on every set until all sets reach the top of the rep range, then add the smallest jump (5 lb upper body, 10 lb lower body).
    - 槓鈴臥推: data {"name":"Barbell Bench Press","nameZh":"槓鈴臥推","best":"225 lb x 8","previousBest":"225 lb x 8","change":0,"bodyweight":0,"flatWindows":3}

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 40 characters.
2. actions: one for each rule above. Each says exactly what to do next week about every item under its rule, naming each one as written above (every muscle, every lift), with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data; as short as covering every item allows. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it. Fit every action to the user's note: if it mentions pain or discomfort in a movement or joint, don't simply add sets or load there; suggest a pain-free alternative or a lighter range, and getting it checked if it persists.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文, Taiwan usage) with full-width punctuation (，。！？「」), and use the Chinese exercise and muscle names given above.
